notes: Fixes the first Shared Sync test where four records moved but the two trip emergency contacts did not. Shared Sync now always includes emergencyContact records from Glenn's authorized master-phone session and marks those copies Shared in the encrypted sync package, while continuing to exclude other Couple-private records. The sync screen also reports how many emergency contacts are included before sending. No source Vault records are relabeled or altered on Glenn's phone by this export rule.
name: TEE v3.4.96 — Emergency Contacts in Shared Sync
